A [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual was the great-uncle of [[Coby]]. After his [[Death/Legends|death]], Coby was given his great-uncle's inheritance [[Currency/Legends|money]] which he would later use to help [[Greej]] return the animals stolen by the [[Starhunter's Intergalactic Menagerie]].<ref name="Coby and the Starhunters" />
